class.name: OpenDustToolRegistry
class.brief_description: The single source of truth for what an agent can do in OpenDust.
class.description: Engine modules and project addons register tools here. [OpenDustAgentServer] lists them to connected agents and dispatches JSON-RPC calls to their handlers. A tool is a name (namespaced like [code]node.create[/code]), a description, a JSON Schema for its parameters, a handler [Callable] and a set of flags. The handler receives two [Dictionary] arguments, [code]params[/code] and [code]context[/code] ([code]session_id[/code], [code]agent_name[/code], [code]agent_id[/code], [code]mode[/code]), and returns a [Dictionary]. To report an error return a dictionary with a [code]$error[/code] key holding [code]{code, message}[/code]; see [method make_error]. Registering or unregistering a tool bumps [method get_capabilities_version] and emits [signal capabilities_changed], which the server forwards to agents as [code]event.capabilities_changed[/code]. See [code]docs/opendust/01-agent-bridge-protocol.md[/code].

method.name: call_tool
method.description: Invokes a tool directly. Returns [code]{result: ...}[/code] on success or [code]{error: {code, message}}[/code] on failure.

method.name: find_room_for_node
method.description: Returns the nearest registered room that is [param node] or one of its ancestors, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_capabilities_version
method.description: Increments every time the tool set changes.

method.name: get_room_node
method.description: The node registered under [param room_id], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_rooms
method.description: Every registered room as [code]{room_id, node_path, room_dir, display_name}[/code].

method.name: get_tool_flags
method.description: The [enum ToolFlags] bitmask of a tool, or [code]0[/code] if unknown.

method.name: list_tools
method.description: Tool specs as [code]{name, description, inputSchema, flags}[/code]. Pass [constant TOOL_EDITOR] or [constant TOOL_RUNTIME] to filter; [code]0[/code] lists all.

method.name: make_error
method.description: Builds the [code]{"$error": {code, message}}[/code] dictionary a handler returns to fail a call.

method.name: register_room
method.description: Registers a room node. Rooms are expected to expose [code]room_dir[/code] and [code]display_name[/code] properties.

method.name: register_tool
method.description: Registers (or replaces) a tool. [param flags] must include [constant TOOL_EDITOR] and/or [constant TOOL_RUNTIME].

signal.name: capabilities_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a tool is registered or removed.
